entries.acquisition_path_detail: The Fourvenues ticketing platform's own public, unauthenticated events API (https://api.fourvenues.com/no-auth/events?slug=opium-barcelona) — reusable ingestion/fourvenues/ family. entries.name: L'Auditori
entries.acquisition_path_detail: A bespoke first-party WordPress plugin ('auditori-plugin') exposing admin-ajax.php?action=get_auditori_events_query — a new, venue-specific module (ingestion/auditori-barcelona/). Follows the site's OWN real from_date-cursor pagination (not the page parameter, which never advances). Music-programme category filtering keeps Symphonic/Chamber Music/Jazz & Pop/New Music/Early Music (plus Robert Gerhard Biennial cicle records) and rejects Social/Educational/museum-tour records. Cross-lists several OTHER real, distinct Barcelona venues (Palau de la Música Catalana, 3 churches/monasteries, Sant Andreu Teatre, ESMUC, Casino de l'Aliança del Poblenou), each independently onboarded. Proven live in research/source-investigations/l-auditori-barcelona-01/.

entries.overlap_notes: Cross-lists real events at several other, independently canonical Barcelona venues — see venues/source-venue-mappings.json's VENUE_NAME-keyed entries for this source.
entries.research_notes: 239 real records observed live across the site's own cursor pagination at proof time; ~152 music-programme-filtered, spanning L'Auditori's own halls plus 7 cross-listed partner venues.

research_provenance.note: Technical acquisition path directly proven live under research/source-investigations/l-auditori-barcelona-01/.
